quests.title: Lost in a Foreign Land

dialogue.t: *cough*... W—Wait! Stop! Who are you? Why are you here...?
And... why are you attacking me?
You are one to talk! We saw you sneaking around!

dialogue.sit: Since you're the bad guy here, why don't you explain yourself first?

dialogue.t: ...Katarina. My name is Katarina Snezhevna.
My name is the most I can divulge. My apologies.
Uh... We just want to know what's happening. We aren't trying to interrogate you!
S—Sorry. That really is all I can disclose.

dialogue.sit: What are the Fatui doing here?

dialogue.t: That's classified.
Come on, bad guys do have a thing for being secretive!
Hehe, you're right. We're the bad guys and that's what we do.
Alright, time's up for the question-and-answer session.. We've got company!
Thank you... for not stabbing me in the back.

dialogue.sit: So, the Fatui all have trust issues, huh?

dialogue.t: Pfft... Although I don't know where you got that impression, this isn't a romantic place to try hitting on me... Come to my hideout if you wish to talk.
Eh? Isn't she a Fatuus? Is it really OK to just let her go instead of sending her to the Millelith?
Hmph... Alright, Paimon gets it. Forget it. She didn't hurt us, after all. Let's let her off the hook this time, shall we?
As expected, you came. Please take a seat.
Lemme see what's left... Black tea is out... Sugar, out too... Alright, here's some milk— Ugh, it's turned sour. Gotta throw it away later. Um, my apologies.
But there is plenty of Fire-Water, plus some hardtack and sour jam to go with it — enough for a tea party.
Whoa...! Do you people really consider Fire-Water to be a standard tea party thing?
Yep, what's the problem with it?

dialogue.sit: We are not here for your tea party...

dialogue.t: What? Hehe, no one's gonna call you out on drinking here. Just suit yourself!
"Sharing food and intel at the right moment is conducive to silencing a curious mouth."
...that's what our handbook says.
Uh? I just shared it.
Huh? Did you tell us anything?
Fatui Advance Team Handbook, Appendix 4-4, Article 32: "Sharing food and intel at the right moment is conducive to silencing a curious mouth." You're welcome.
You saved my life and in return, I divulged classified content from our handbook. Hehe, how's that for sincerity?
What's the use of that!?
Hehe, jokes aside... Actually, I'm very grateful for your help, but my kind gesture doesn't mean anything else.
Uh... with what you people have done, Paimon finds it hard to believe in your "kind gesture"...

dialogue.sit: What are you up to, really?

dialogue.t: It's no surprise that outsiders fail to understand the cause of the Fatui. But when we aren't talking about what we pursue or which side we are on, we are just a bunch of ordinary people.
...Besides, all our agendas and deeds are just preparatory work for the final battle.
Yes, in the end, all of us shall face a common enemy and the inescapable long night... Everyone in Snezhnaya has been thusly warned.
So, every drop of tears and blood of mankind, shed for the sake of this cruel world... They shall not be shed in vain.
Let's have a toast! No? Hmph, I'll just suit myself...

dialogue.sit: Is this how you justify the evil you've done?

dialogue.t: Maybe you're right... I don't know, nor do I care to know. You wanted an explanation, and I gave you one. You're free to not find it to your liking. That's all.
Ugh... Where did all that deep stuff suddenly come from...
By the way, I've introduced myself, but I don't know your name yet.

dialogue.sit: You might've heard about me. I'm {NICKNAME}.

dialogue.t: And Paimon's Paimon!
Oh! Your names...!
Hehehe! We're pretty well-known all over the Teyvat, aren't we?
Sorry, I've never heard of you... Either of you, actually.
What!?
Please don't take it the wrong way — I was sent down here a long time ago. I barely know anything about what's happening on the surface save for the news we get through our supply lines.
Eh... Doesn't that mean...

dialogue.sit: That your supply line's long been cut off?

dialogue.t: Tea party's over! I need to get some rest. Excuse me!
Hey! We haven't even started eating yet!
Leave already! Didn't you just frown upon my Fire-Water?
That's because Paimon didn't think it was drinkable at all!

dialogue.sit: People have different food preferences, y'know...

dialogue.t: Hmph!
By the way, uh...! {NICKNAME}, please wait—
Uh, it's nothing. I'm just thinking... that if it were you...
Please come back another day... if you don't find it too troublesome.

quests.description: You run into a less-hostile Fatui mage in The Chasm. What is she doing here?
